notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Repo ships GGUF only (no config.json); base_model in the card front matter is Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B, and the GGUF itself reports qwen35.block_count 24, attention.head_count 8, attention.head_count_kv 2, key_length/value_length 256, context_length 262144. Base text_config layer_types marks 6 of 24 layers full_attention (full_attention_interval 4; layers 3,7,11,15,19,23) - only those keep KV: 6 layers x 2 KV heads x head_dim 256 x 2 (K,V) x 2 B (bf16) = 12,288 B/token. The 18 Gated DeltaNet linear_attention layers hold a fixed-size recurrent state, not per-token KV. Context 262,144 = GGUF context_length and base max_position_embeddings (agree). REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card (261018 tables) publishes matching scores for all six claimed rows.
